RECOMMENDATION

Staff recommends that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2025-014,
recommending City Council approval of Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 25-0002,
and find that the project is consistent with Program Environmental Impact Report (PEIR)
22-002 prepared and certified in conjunction with the City’s General Plan (Palmdale
2045).

BACKGROUND

On September 21, 2022, Palmdale 2045 was adopted by the City Council and replaced
the previously adopted General Plan (1993). State law requires that the regulations
governing the use and development of lands within the municipal limits of a city be
consistent with the adopted General Plan for that city. ZOA 21-007 was adopted by the
City Council on March 15, 2023, which amended Title 17 of the Palmdale Municipal Code
(PMC) to implement the vision of Palmdale 2045 as well as support new land use patterns
and future development. Since then, staff have identified minor amendments to Title 17
which are necessary to streamline approval processes for uses within commercial zones.
 Staff Report to the Planning Commission
Reso. No. PC-2025-014
July 10, 2025
Page 2

ANALYSIS

Staff recommends that the Planning Commission recommend City Council approval of
the proposed amendments to the commercial land use regulations to clarify and
streamline processes and improve the consistency of allowed uses.

Streamline Approval Processes

This update will allow approval for bona fide restaurants and commercial recreation and
sports uses administratively rather than through a Conditional Use Permit (CUP).

In addition, staff recommends adding a new land use to address the sale of on-sale
alcohol as an accessory use. This new land use is intended to provide flexibility to
businesses, such as commercial recreation uses, wishing to establish incidental on-sale
alcohol sales through an administrative process in commercial zones, which may not
otherwise be able to meet the requirements of a bona fide restaurant. Furthermore, staff
recommends a minor change to the parking calculation table for commercial recreation
uses to clarify project requirements.

Furthermore, cottage food operations, the preparation or packaging of limited types of
food in a private home for sale to consumers, are an allowable land use within any zone
that allows residential uses, with administrative approval. Therefore, staff will be updating
the land use table to allow cottage food operations in other zones that also allow housing.

Consistency of Allowable Uses

The Employment Flex General Plan land use designation and Office Flex (OFX) zone is
also intended to transition between intensive service, retail, and commercial uses and
lighter industrial uses. As such, some land uses that are allowed in light industrial zones
and commercial zones have been included as permitted uses in the OFX zone:

    Animal Sales and Services
    Nursery/Garden Center
    Tattoo/Body Art/ Piercing
    Bar/Nightclub/Lounge
    Brewpub/Taproom/Wine Bar/Micro distillery

ENVIRONMENTAL REVIEW

PEIR 22-002 (State Clearinghouse # 2021060494) was prepared and certified by the City
Council (Resolution No. CC 2022-096) on September 21, 2022, for approval Palmdale
2045. As part of the environmental analysis, PEIR 22-002 also considered the adoption
and implementation of the Comprehensive Zoning Code and Map update. Staff review
has determined that a subsequent or supplemental PEIR as described in California
Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Sections 15162, 15163, or 15164, is not
required because the proposed ZOA would not require major revisions to the PEIR, there
are no significant changes in circumstances and there is no new information of substantial
importance that will involve new significant environmental effects or increase the severity
of previously identified significant effects. Any future projects would be required to go
through separate environmental reviews, as this ZOA is only amending commercial land
use regulations. As such, staff concluded that the request is consistent with the previous
PEIR in accordance with CEQA Guidelines and has determined that no additional
environmental analysis is required.

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  PALMDALE, RECOMMENDING CITY COUNCIL APPROVAL OF ZONING

  WHEREAS, The City of Palmdale (City) has filed an application that applies to the
City and the City’s sphere of influence, requesting approval of Zoning Ordinance
Amendment (ZOA) 25-0002, to modify commercial land use regulations within the Zoning
Ordinance, as indicated in Exhibits A and B (hereinafter referred to as “Application”).

  WHEREAS, State law requires that the regulations governing the use and
development of lands within the municipal limits of a city be consistent with the adopted
General Plan for that city. On September 21, 2022, the City Council adopted a
comprehensive update to the General Plan (Palmdale 2045), which required a
comprehensive update to Title 17 of the Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC).

  WHEREAS, On March 15, 2023, the City Council of the City of Palmdale adopted
Ordinance No. 1603, a comprehensive Zoning Code and Map update.

  WHEREAS, On August 16, 2023, the City Council of the City of Palmdale adopted
Ordinance Nos. 1613 and 1614, which identified minor amendments to the PMC
necessary to address inconsistencies, clarify review procedures, correct typographical
errors and section references, as well as update the associated Zoning Map.

  WHEREAS, On December 6, 2023, the City Council of the City of Palmdale adopted
Ordinance No. 1627, which identified minor amendments to Title 17 necessary to address
inconsistencies and clarify review procedures.

  WHEREAS, On February 7, 2024, the City Council of the City of Palmdale adopted
Ordinance No. 1639, which amended the Noise Element of the General Plan, the
Development Standards for Mixed-Use zones, the Land Use map, and Zoning map to
address inconsistencies and clarify review procedures.

  WHEREAS, On December 22, 2024, the City Council of the City of Palmdale
adopted Ordinance No. 1647, to address review procedures and streamline review
processes for City projects.

  WHEREAS, On June 12, 2025, the Planning Commission of the City of Palmdale
adopted Resolution No. PC-2025-012, to address residential development standards for
single-family residences and accessory dwelling units (ADUs) as required by State law.

  SECTION 3. Based upon substantial evidence presented to this Commission
during the above-referenced July 10, 2025, public hearing, including public testimony,
and written and oral staff report, this Commission specifically finds as follows:

  A  The proposed ZOA conforms with the goals, objectives, and policies of the
  General Plan.

  B  The proposed ZOA is necessary to implement the General Plan and to
  provide public safety, convenience, and/or general welfare.

  The proposed ZOA is consistent with the General Plan as discussed in
  Exhibit B. For example, General Plan Goal ED-2: Attract diverse and high-
  quality job options that contribute to the City’s economic growth by
  diversifying the economic base, because the proposed amendment will
  clarify and streamline approval processes and expand business potential,
  which will attract businesses to the City. Furthermore, the proposed ZOA is
  consistent with Goal LUD-18: Attraction and stimulation of new employment
  uses through flexible land use regulations and supportive policies/actions
  because the amendment will provide flexibility to commercial areas, while
  still allowing review and evaluation of site-specific requirements and
  characteristics and adherence to development regulations and performance
  standards.

  In addition, approval of the proposed ZOA will provide greater flexibility for
  commercial development standards, clarify approval processes, and
  provide a path for compatible uses to operate within appropriate zones,
  consistent with General Plan goals to attract new businesses and increase
  new employment opportunities in Palmdale.

  SECTION 4. Based on the findings and conclusions outlined in paragraphs 1 and
2, and 3, this Commission recommends City Council approval of ZOA 25-0002, as shown
in Exhibits A and B, and finds that the project is consistent with PEIR 22-002 prepared
and certified for Palmdale 2045.
